sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

rows: [UNIT_CONVERSION] SectionModulusQuantityShape, ShearAreaQuantityShape, ReducedLineLoadQuantityShape, and both SPARQL constraints: The candidate identifies required QUDT units with the schema namespace (for example, http://qudt.org/schema/qudt/CentiM3) instead of the authoritative QUDT unit namespace (http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/CentiM3); the same mismatch occurs for CentiM2 and KiloN-PER-M. Consequently, valid quantities using the canonical units will not satisfy the shapes or SPARQL unit patterns. Required change: Use the canonical QUDT unit IRIs under http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/ for CentiM3, CentiM2, and KiloN-PER-M in every sh:hasValue and SPARQL unit comparison, while retaining the schema namespace for qudt:unit and qudt:numericValue predicates.

[APPLICABILITY] gs:TRF055NarrowDeckStripShape/sh:property[nltl:abreastOfHatch] and gs:TRF055NarrowDeckStripShape/sh:property[nltl:servesAsIceStringer]: The shape targets every nltl:narrowDeckStrip but requires both applicability conditions to be present exactly once and true, thereby rejecting narrow deck strips that are not abreast of hatches or do not serve as ice stringers, although the requirement applies only when both conditions hold. Required change: Encode abreastOfHatch and servesAsIceStringer as applicability gates for the substantive compliance constraints rather than unconditional true-valued requirements on every targeted narrowDeckStrip. | [MANDATORY_CONDITION] gs:TRF055NarrowDeckStripShape/sh:property[nltl:veryLongHatchOpening]: The shape unconditionally requires every targeted narrow deck strip to provide a veryLongHatchOpening boolean, but the requirement mentions very long hatches only as a conditional exception for the permitted reduced line load. Required change: Remove the unconditional minCount requirement for veryLongHatchOpening and use it only to govern validation of the optional reduced-line-load exception, with any required presence behavior explicitly limited to that exception.

[WRONG_APPLICABILITY] gs:TRF055NarrowDeckStripShape/sh:sparql[3]: The reduced-line-load exception constraint is evaluated for every narrowDeckStrip carrying permittedReducedLineLoad, without requiring abreastOfHatch=true and servesAsIceStringer=true. This rejects reduced-line-load data on strips outside the requirement's applicability scope. Required change: Add the base applicability conditions abreastOfHatch=true and servesAsIceStringer=true to the reduced-line-load exception constraint, or otherwise scope that constraint to the applicable strips. | [DATATYPE_QUANTITY_ACCESS] gs:TRF055NarrowDeckStripShape/sh:property[nltl:reducedLineLoadApprovedByClassificationSociety]: The approval property has sh:maxCount but no sh:datatype xsd:boolean, despite the canonical property being an xsd:boolean. Consequently, non-boolean approval values are not rejected by the property shape and may evade the SPARQL boolean test. Required change: Add sh:datatype xsd:boolean to the reducedLineLoadApprovedByClassificationSociety property constraint.
No concrete blocking defect detected in the current candidate.
